title: Buttons | Apple Developer Documentation - [Help buttons](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons\#Help-buttons)
claim: Avoid displaying text that introduces a help button.** People know what a help button does, so they don’t need additional descriptive text.
